svg.text: The oldest machines were built by believers: Pascal (1642) and Leibniz (1703). Lovelace's “no pretensions to originate” is a 180-year-old Berean caution.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Source Serif Pro', serif

svg.text: Two winters, both from overpromising. Then data, chips, and the transformer arrived together; in 2024 the Nobel committees called it science.
